guideImpact.affectedSection: Open Dashboards from the V4 launcher
guideImpact.reason: Users need instructions for opening the Dashboards module from the V4 launcher and returning to the launcher with browser Back. The reviewed behaviour introduces a visible navigation path and a Dashboards placeholder that users may need explained.

guideUpdate.title: Open Dashboards from the V4 launcher and return
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Open Dashboards from the V4 launcher
steps: Select Open Dashboards on the Dashboards card.
View the Dashboards Under construction placeholder and explanatory content.
Use the browser Back control to return to the launcher.
Confirm that the Dashboards card is visible again.
